title: Corrigendum to ‘Osseodensification versus conventional drilling in dental implantology: An umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses’ [J Prosthet Dent 2026;136:e129-e135…
html: The authors regret that reference 26 was incorrectly cited and should be replaced with the following: 26. Shea BJ, Reeves BC, Wells G, Thuku M, Hamel C, Moran J, Moher D, Tugwell P, Welch V, Kristjansson E, Henry DA. AMSTAR 2: a critical appraisal tool for systematic reviews that include randomised or nonrandomised studies of healthcare interventions, or both. BMJ 2017;358:j4008.>.
